research_question: Early-warning reliability under capacity constraints: can a capacity-limited alert system warn about BTC 4% intraday crashes before the decline starts, as opposed to detecting a decline already in progress?

data.source: Binance public monthly 1-minute kline archives (data.binance.vision), spot BTCUSDT (primary), USD-M futures BTCUSDT (original study, notebook 13), spot ETH/SOL/DOGE/AVAX (notebook 10)
data.integrity: each archive checked against its published .CHECKSUM (SHA-256); see DATA_PROVENANCE.csv
data.grid: complete UTC minute grid; gaps of <=5 minutes forward-filled (OHLC) with zero volume; longer gaps left missing
data.timestamps: spot archives use microseconds from 2025; parsed by magnitude
data.venue_guard: spot cache must match spot archive values (fingerprint) and carry DATA_SOURCE.json venue=spot

event_definition.rule: close <= 96% of the maximum close of the previous 240 minutes (breach), held for 5 consecutive closes; the 240 minutes before the breach fully observed; a new peak after the previous event; 24 h refractory after the previous confirmation

timestamps.peak: argmax close in the previous 240 minutes
timestamps.onset: first close <= 99% of the peak (1% onset)

event_definition.alt_coins: 4% scaled by the coin's 2021 median daily realized volatility relative to BTC (notebook 10)
event_definition.evaluation_events: breach in [period start + 4 h, period end) so every warning window lies inside the period

endpoints.early_warning_pre_onset: matched alert 30-240 min before the breach AND before the 1% onset
endpoints.in_progress_detection_post_onset: matched alert 30-240 min before the breach, at or after the 1% onset
endpoints.composite_caught: pre + post; called "caught" in notebooks 1-11. Reference only: an increase in the composite must not be read as better early warning
endpoints.onset_anchored_secondary: alert within 240 min before the 1% onset (notebook 12)
endpoints.eligibility: pre-onset possible only if onset-to-breach gap < 240 min; post-onset only if gap >= 30 min
endpoints.matching: each event takes the earliest unused alert in [breach-240, breach-30] min; each alert serves at most one event
endpoints.reporting_rule: every result table reports pre-onset and post-onset separately; the composite is never the sole basis of a claim

features.z_vol: log realized volatility over 31 one-minute returns, z-scored against the previous 30 days
features.tsr: taker sell ratio = (volume - taker buy volume) / volume in the minute

model.classifier: StandardScaler + LogisticRegression(C=0.2, class_weight=balanced, lbfgs, max_iter=400, random_state=17)
model.label: 1 if a 4% breach occurs 30-240 min after the minute
model.training: 2021 calendar year minus the last 245 minutes (no label leakage into 2022)
model.calibration: 2022 only, no outcome labels: the score threshold that lets the calendar scheduler use the most alerts (cap 240), then the strictest (fewest raw candidates); bucket policies: closest to 240 alerts, strictest on ties

capacity.primary: calendar scheduler: at most 20 alerts per UTC month, 240 per UTC year, 240-minute cooldown

variants.notebook 4: budgets 60/120/240/480 per year; schedulers calendar, rolling30, paced, token_bucket
variants.notebook 9: budget-neutral risk bucket, surge reserve (16/month base + 48/yr reserve accruing 4/month)
variants.notebook 10: five coins pooled 1,200/yr and 100/month vs 240/yr each

costs.notebook_1_decision_cost: cost points = 50 x missed event + 1 x false alarm + 10 x lateness; scenarios in weight_sensitivity.csv; hypothetical weights, not money
costs.notebook_4_stylized_hedge: on each alert reduce exposure by 50% for 240 min; enter at the next positive-volume minute (<=5 min wait); overlapping hedges merged; one-way fee 10 bp primary, grid 0/5/10/25 bp on each exposure change; compared with an exposure-matched buy-and-hold; illustrative, not live trading

multiple_testing.confirmatory: only notebook 11 (2018-2020 one-shot holdout): H1 one-sided circular-shift permutation (alpha 0.05); H2 three one-sided exact McNemar tests with Holm; H3 descriptive; H4 none selected
multiple_testing.exploratory: all other p-values are unadjusted and descriptive (2023-2026 was inspected repeatedly); RESULTS_TESTS.csv adds a within-notebook Holm column for reference only
multiple_testing.clustered_events: notebook 12 re-tests pooled vs separate budgets with shock- and month-level sign-flip permutation

status_vocabulary.confirmatory: hypothesis, thresholds and test fixed (hashed) before the data were read; evaluated once (lock file)
status_vocabulary.frozen replay: fixed policy replayed on later data (notebook 7); not a never-seen sample
status_vocabulary.post-hoc audit: checks assumptions of a locked test without changing it
